summary.text: Charlie Melvin is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Rockingham 20 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 primary.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia, which lists him as Charles Melvin Sr., gives his tenure in the New Hampshire House of Representatives as beginning in 2018.
